cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, introspective mood established by the instrumental introduction, maintaining a consistent atmosphere of wistful longing throughout.
cards.palette: A solo acoustic guitar serves as the sole harmonic and melodic foundation, utilizing a fingerstyle technique that weaves bass lines, chords, and melodic fills simultaneously.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Shadows stretch across the floor,
Dust settles by the door,
The cooling wind begins to sigh,
Underneath a fading sky.
[Pre-Chorus]
The sun is sinking low,
Watching the day-light flow.
[Chorus]
Oh, the hollow and the hill,
Time is moving, standing still,
Tracing paths of silver light,
Before the world turns into night.
[Verse]
Old wood groans a weary tune,
Beneath the ghost of a moon,
The memories pile like stones,
In the marrow of my bones.
[Pre-Chorus]
The fire starts to fade,
In the garden that I made.
[Chorus]
Oh, the hollow and the hill,
Time is moving, standing still,
Tracing paths of silver light,
Before the world turns into night.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The river hums a song,
Where the heavy shadows belong.
[Chorus]
Oh, the hollow and the hill,
Time is moving, standing still,
Tracing paths of silver light,
Before the world turns into night.
[Outro]
